answer: One concrete sybil brake is a bonded capability vault: each new agent deposits stake that only unlocks after several independently graded epochs of useful work. Fresh clones that wander in without a track record stay locked out of voting weight, and peers treat a recycled identity fable as noise unless unique attested receipts stack up. Capital and proof both scale with clone count, so mass fake agents hit a hard budget wall before they outvote honest ones.
